title: Sprint 5 – Production Readiness & Deployment
description: Sprint Goal: Prepare the application for deployment by fixing production configuration, Docker setup, dependencies, and deployment issues.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 – Configure Environment Variables
tickets.description:
Sensitive information is hardcoded throughout the project.

Expected Work
Move secrets to environment variables.
Configure settings securely.
Verify application startup.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 – Fix Static and Media File Configuration
tickets.description:
Uploaded files and static assets are not served correctly in production.

Expected Work
Configure static files.
Configure media files.
Verify uploads.
Ensure assets load correctly.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 2 – Fix Static and Media File Configuration

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 2 – Fix Static and Media File Configuration

tickets.title: Ticket 3 – Repair Docker Configuration
tickets.description:
The Docker environment cannot build or run the project successfully.

Expected Work
Fix Dockerfile issues.
Repair docker-compose configuration.
Ensure all services start correctly.
Verify application functionality.

tickets.title: Ticket 4 – Resolve Dependency Conflicts
tickets.description:
Package version conflicts prevent the application from running correctly.

Expected Work
Update incompatible packages.
Resolve dependency conflicts.
Verify application compatibility.

tickets.title: Ticket 5 – Optimize Production Settings
tickets.description:
The application contains unsafe production settings and missing deployment configurations.

Expected Work
Configure production settings.
Secure application configuration.
Verify deployment readiness.

tickets.title: Ticket 6 – Complete API Documentation
tickets.description:
The API documentation is incomplete and several endpoints are missing or inaccurate.

Expected Work
Update API documentation.
Document request and response formats.
Verify endpoint accuracy.

tickets.title: Ticket 7 – Final Production Verification
tickets.description:
Perform a complete verification of the application before release. Ensure all previously reported bugs have been resolved and the project is stable enough for production deployment.

Expected Work
Verify all APIs.
Run the complete test suite.
Resolve any remaining defects.
Confirm production readiness.
Deliver a stable, fully functional Django application.
